name: Christopher Fairbank
profileSummary: Christopher E. Fairbank is an English actor. He is best known in the UK for playing Moxey in the comedy-drama series Auf Wiedersehen, Pet. Fairbank has had roles in Coronation Street, Batman, Doctor Who and Shakespeare & Hathaway: Private Investigators. He has a recurring role in the Guardians of the Galaxy films as The Broker, and in two guest stints in 2024 and 2026, portrayed Eddie Knight in EastEnders.
